name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A set of habits you install into your AI coding assistant so it asks what you actually want, writes a plan, and tests its work, instead of guessing and rushing straight to code.
buyer: A software consultancy owner who sells 'AI-accelerated development' to clients and needs a repeatable, trustworthy process to point to instead of ad-hoc vibe coding.
business_use_cases: A dev shop adopts it as their house methodology so every client engagement follows the same spec-first, test-driven process regardless of which engineer or agent runs it.
A solo founder uses it to let an AI agent work unattended for hours on a feature without drifting off the agreed plan, cutting down on review time.
A coding bootcamp licenses the methodology as the backbone of an 'AI-assisted engineering' course module, since it's a complete teachable workflow.

money_ideas.idea: Sell paid onboarding and training for engineering teams adopting the workflow, since it changes how a team plans and reviews work.
Build a companion dashboard-as-a-service that tracks spec/plan/test compliance across a team's repos using this methodology.

steal_this: It's free and already extremely popular (300k+ stars), so there's no product to resell here — the real weekend move is becoming visibly good at using it and selling 'we build with Superpowers' as a trust signal to prospective clients.
